title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory): deduplicate SChartsAndTransferOfGoodLevel via TrivBound
body:
Remove 32 duplicated helper declarations from `SChartsAndTransferOfGoodLevel.lean` (`GlobalTheory.Reg.ChartInt` and `GlobalTheory.Reg.Transfer`) and reuse the identical declarations already imported from `CombinedBoundAtTrivialValuationsOfCharts.lean` (`GlobalTheory.Reg.TrivBound`) as well as `GlobalTheory.Reg.ChartInt.nonneg_at_all_points`.

Removed declarations in `GlobalTheory.Reg.ChartInt`:
- `chval_eq`, `chval_div`, `chval_nonneg`, `transfer`, `nonneg_at_trivial`, `qpt_mem_trivSet` (reused from `GlobalTheory.Reg.TrivBound`: `chval_eq`, `chval_div`, `chval_nonneg`, `transfer''`, `nonneg_triv`, `ordQ_mem_trivSet`)

Removed declarations in `GlobalTheory.Reg.Transfer`:
- `vV_nonneg`, `mem_of_vV_nonneg`, `chval_eq`, `chval_div`, `chval_nonneg`, `vr`, `nval_eq_vr`, `vr_mul`, `vr_one`, `chval_fin_iff`, `chval_fin_mul`, `chval_fin_one`, `chval_fin_inv`, `chval_fin_alg`, `chval_fin_zpow`, `regular_at_centre`, `comb_core`, `ratio_ge`, `w_fin`, `limit_lam`, `limit_triv` (all reused from `GlobalTheory.Reg.TrivBound`)
- `regular_at_centre_chart`, `nonneg_at`, `integral_place`, `integral_trivial`, `combined_trivial` (reused from `GlobalTheory.Reg.ChartInt.nonneg_at_all_points`, `GlobalTheory.Reg.TrivBound.nonneg_triv`, and `GlobalTheory.Reg.TrivBound.comb_triv`)
